text:
Which statements about monomers or polymers are correct?
1
Monomers are always joined together by addition reactions.
2
A polymer can be formed from a single type of monomer.
3
A polymer can be formed by joining two different types of monomer.
4
Water is always produced when monomer molecules join together.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
